seen.where: openapi.bnf.fr IIIF images of Gallica ark btv1b9060066q (BnF fr. 3027, 123 views; the Gallica description opens with letters of admiral Bonnivet to the marshal de Montmorency, which confirms the shelfmark), 14 Nov 2026
seen.extent: One letter looked at: view 69 (Omont's no. 34, 'f. 67'; Omont's folio numbers are an older foliation and do not match the modern stamp, see the 2996 note) is a letter written in cipher signs (about 20 lines of symbols run together with a few plain words), addressed on a following view 'A monsr le mareschal de Montmorency'. The other places Omont names (nos. 49, 70, 72; ff. 100-202) were not opened.
seen.cipher: Symbol cipher in a 16th-century cursive hand, the plain-text passages interleaved; no interlinear or marginal decipherment on the leaf and no clear copy on the facing view.

prior_art.decode: decode_search.py, 14 Nov 2026: 'Bonnivet' 0 records; 'Montmorency' returns only BnF NAF 4206 (Dinteville and du Bellay, R9467-9477), none from fr. 3027 (the DECODE id 3027 in the Cryptoole snapshot is an unrelated British Library record).
prior_art.tomokiyo: Tomokiyo's GL.htm page (copy in targets/gramont1529) lists Lasry's deciphered Montmorency-period ciphers in fr. 3015, 3022, 3029, 3092 and fr. 2996; fr. 3027 is not named there. Web search for 'fr. 3027' with Bonnivet/Montmorency (14 Nov 2026) found nothing.
prior_art.lasry: Not in the GL.htm copy held here; the AI-assisted list (sect. 4) is not held locally and was not re-read, so a reading there is not excluded.
prior_art.edition: No printed edition of the Bonnivet-Montmorency letters of fr. 3027 found; Omont's catalogue lists the pieces 'en chiffre' without a decipherment.
prior_art.literature: Nothing found by web search (14 Nov 2026).

lead_updates.folio_note: fr. 3027: Omont nos. 34, 49, 70, 72 (his ff. 67, 100-105, 182, 186-202); cipher letter seen at view 69.

2734.closed: The Morvillier despatch from Venice of 24 Jan 1546 is the 'de Morvillier's cipher (1546)' deciphered on Tomokiyo's GL.htm page (BnF fr. 2996 f. 52 no. 25, Gallica; Lasry's key), so its decipherment exists. Seen on Gallica views 98-99 of ark btv1b9060087w: a full-page symbol cipher letter, Omont's 'f. 33' being the old foliation (modern view 60 is a plain letter stamped 33). The fr. 3137 despatch of 12 Nov 1549 (same ambassador, key letter said to be in fr. 3138 f. 70) was not opened; a separate lead may be made for it if it is not covered. (14 Nov 2026)
